# Vendored Cosmos Policy Runtime

This directory contains the Cosmos Policy implementation required by the
StarVTLA Dream-Tac adapter. It is vendored so Dream-Tac does not depend on the
ignored `ref_repo/` tree or an independently installed `cosmos-policy` package.

- Upstream: <https://github.com/LYFCLOUDFAN/Dream-Tac.git>
- Upstream commit: `14bab51d6862fd07124745c55cd395ea5caa9fd3`
- License: Apache-2.0; see `LICENSE`
- Third-party notices: see `ATTRIBUTIONS.md`

StarVTLA carries two compatibility changes:

1. `cosmos_policy/config/experiment/cosmos_policy_experiment_configs.py`
   resolves the base checkpoint from `COSMOS_POLICY_BASE_CHECKPOINT`.
2. `cosmos_policy/_src/predict2/text_encoders/text_encoder.py` constructs the
   optional Reason1/Qwen configuration lazily. Cached Dream-Tac T5 contexts do
   not use it, and eager construction is incompatible with Transformers 5.x.

Generated bytecode and caches are intentionally excluded from the vendored
copy.
